name: dist_coe_center_sq
statement: ℍ) (r : ℝ) : dist (z : ℂ) (w.center r) ^ 2 = 2 * z.im * w.im * (Real.cosh (dist z w) - Real.cosh r) + (w.im * Real.sinh r) ^ 2

name: cmp_dist_eq_cmp_dist_coe_center
statement: ℍ) (r : ℝ) : cmp (dist z w) r = cmp (dist (z : ℂ) (w.center r)) (w.im * Real.sinh r)

name: le_dist_iff_le_dist_coe_center
statement: r < dist z w ↔ w.im * Real.sinh r < dist (z : ℂ) (w.center r)
